text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2024. Earth-observation tools detected small patches of tree-cover loss totaling 0.7 hectares in that year. While these were below the 0.5-hectare threshold to be counted as a formal event, they still indicate actual tree-cover loss. The property also experienced a corroborated 0.7-hectare loss event in 2023. These changes reflect stand-replacement events (e.g., clearing or harvesting) rather than deforestation or land-use change.
